summary: The Wolfë S∀MØS / E.D.I.T.H. Engine is a cryptographic verification system designed to protect the integrity of digital files and datasets. It generates a unique SHA-256 fingerprint of any file and anchors that fingerprint onto the Solana blockchain through public memo records. If even a single byte of the file is altered, the cryptographic match fails, providing immediate and mathematically verifiable proof of authenticity.This addresses a critical need in high-stakes scientific and research environments: confirming that data has remained unaltered from the moment it was created through analysis and sharing. The system is live and publicly accessible. Users can upload a file, generate its hash, and instantly check whether it matches the on-chain record.By combining simple cryptographic hashing with blockchain immutability, E.D.I.T.H. turns file integrity verification from a manual process into an automated, transparent check.
details:
E.D.I.T.H. works by generating a SHA-256 hash of any uploaded file and comparing it against records previously written to Solana Devnet memo accounts. A match confirms the file is identical to the version that was originally anchored. A mismatch immediately flags that the file has been altered.

Key benefits:

  • Immediate, mathematical proof of file integrity
  • Public and independent verification (no central authority required)
  • Lightweight and browser-based

Tools used:

  • Solana blockchain (memo program)
  • SHA-256 cryptographic hashing
  • Web-based frontend
  • Google Cloud infrastructure for hosting

The project is creative in its simplicity: it takes a fundamental cryptographic method and makes it practical and accessible for verifying scientific and research data without complex infrastructure.
projectRefs: Wolfë Ledger Check — Proof-of-Existence Demonstration (Solana Devnet)
